Program_Info.Program_Change_Info: Added vendor-neutral real-time GPU telemetry via DXGI/D3DKMT (GPU usage, 60s sparklines, Dedicated VRAM / Shared GPU memory, temperature, and GPU model), integrated GPU metrics into all 3 layouts (including Compact Mini 5-gauge bar), 4 themes, 1-click copy, full snapshot report, and tray tooltip, plus smart multi-GPU handling and hybrid laptop D3cold sleep protection.

English.Char_Desc_80: Ultra-lightweight native Windows HUD for live PC, GPU, and network metrics.
English.Char_Desc_250: Simple Stats is an ultra-lightweight single-file native desktop telemetry HUD for Windows 10/11. Monitor CPU, GPU (VRAM/temp), RAM, Disk I/O, per-drive space, and active NIC metrics with Wallpaper Layer or Ghost Overlay modes and 60s sparklines.
English.Char_Desc_450: Simple Stats is a standalone native Windows 10/11 telemetry HUD built with Win32/GDI+ and .NET 10 NativeAOT (~3.0 MB). Track CPU, GPU (VRAM/SHM/temp via DXGI/D3DKMT), RAM, physical Disk I/O, drive space, and active NIC metrics with 60s sparklines. Includes Wallpaper Layer & mouse-fading Ghost Overlay modes, Fullscreen Auto-Pause, 4 themes, 3 layouts, 3 fonts, 1-click copy, zero-registry Startup, and EN/JA UI.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
Simple Stats: An ultra-lightweight desktop telemetry HUD for Windows.
Simple Stats is a standalone, single-file desktop telemetry HUD rebuilt on native Win32 / GDI+ rendering and .NET 10 NativeAOT with zero third-party UI libraries (~3.0 MB executable, minimal memory footprint, near-zero CPU).
Key features: - High-Precision Monitoring & 60s Sparklines: Track Task Manager-aligned CPU utility (PDH % Processor Utility / CPUID), vendor-neutral GPU utilization, VRAM/Shared memory & temperature (DXGI / D3DKMT with multi-GPU and D3cold laptop sleep protection), RAM usage, unprivileged deduplicated physical disk I/O, per-drive Used & Free capacity bars, and network throughput (Kbps/Mbps/Gbps) with arc gauges and 60-second sparklines. - Non-Intrusive Dual Display Modes & Fullscreen Auto-Pause: Choose between Wallpaper Layer Mode (pinned behind windows, survives Win+D, hidden from Taskbar / Alt+Tab) and Ghost Overlay Mode (always-on-top click-through with automatic mouse-proximity fade and Ctrl+Alt temporary unlock), plus Fullscreen Auto-Pause that automatically hides the HUD and suspends rendering/timers while a fullscreen game or presentation runs on the same monitor, restoring it on exit. - 4 Themes, 3 Slim Layouts & 3 Font Sizes: Switch between Obsidian Glass, Pure Wallpaper, Cyber Cyan, and Frost Light across Standard, Minimal Zen, and Compact Mini layouts with Small / Medium / Large font scaling. - Active NIC Auto-Tracking & 1-Click Copy: Automatically follows the active adapter (Adapter, IPv4/CIDR, Subnet, Gateway, DNS) and copies any clicked host, CPU, GPU, drive, or network row—or the full system snapshot—to the clipboard. - Zero-Registry & Auto-Localized: Toggle Startup (SimpleStats.lnk) with zero Windows Registry writes and automatic English / Japanese UI switching (--lang=en / --lang=ja).
Developed by chilili kobo. Freeware for personal and commercial use.
